<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Sour Paint Studios — Songbook</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 viewBox=%220 0 100 100%22><text y=%22.9em%22 font-size=%2290%22>🎤</text></svg>">
<style>
/* ============================================================
   Sour Paint Studios — Songbook
   Design tokens
   ============================================================ */
:root {
  --green: #6FB92C;
  --green-bright: #93D83E;
  --yellow: #F0DE00;
  --ink: #121210;
  --ink-soft: #1c1c19;
  --paper: #F7F4EC;
  --paper-soft: #FFFFFF;
  --line-dark: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  --line-light: rgba(0,0,0,0.10);

  --bg: var(--paper);
  --bg-elevated: var(--paper-soft);
  --text: var(--ink);
  --text-dim: rgba(18,18,16,0.62);
  --line: var(--line-light);
  --danger: #D9432E;

  --radius: 18px;
  --radius-sm: 12px;
  --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(18,18,16,0.10);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: var(--ink);
  --bg-elevated: var(--ink-soft);
  --text: #F3F1E8;
  --text-dim: rgba(243,241,232,0.62);
  --line: var(--line-dark);
  --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
    --bg: var(--ink);
    --bg-elevated: var(--ink-soft);
    --text: #F3F1E8;
    --text-dim: rgba(243,241,232,0.62);
    --line: var(--line-dark);
    --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
  }
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { height: 100%; }
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: 'Sour Body', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  overscroll-behavior-y: none;
  /* Text on-screen here isn't meant to be selected — a stray long-press on
     a title was triggering the phone/browser's native selection UI (and,
     inside the Claude app's artifact viewer, its comment-on-selection
     prompt), which then sat on top of the app with no way through it.
     Inputs and the lyrics textarea opt back in below since those are
     meant to be typed/edited/selected normally. */
  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; -webkit-touch-callout: none;
}
input, textarea {
  user-select: text; -webkit-user-select: text; -webkit-touch-callout: default;
}
h1, h2, h3 { font-family: 'Sour Display', 'Sour Body', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, sans-serif; margin: 0; }
button { font-family: inherit; }
img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

/* Progressive-enhancement font loading: the stack above already reads well
   with system fonts alone, since this app needs to work without wifi on stage. */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Sour Display';
  src: local('Space Grotesk'), url('https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/spacegrotesk/v16/V8mQoQDjQSkFtoMM3T6r8E7mPbF4C_qbHwYRlw.woff2') format('woff2');
  font-weight: 500 700;
  font-display: swap;
}
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Sour Body';
  src: local('Inter');
  font-display: swap;
}

.hidden { display: none !important; }

/* ---------- Splash ---------- */
#splash {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 999;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-direction: column; gap: 18px;
  background: var(--ink);
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
}
#splash.splash-out { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
#splash img {
  width: 168px; height: 168px; object-fit: contain;
  animation: splash-in 0.9s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1) both;
}
#splash .splash-caption {
  color: rgba(243,241,232,0.55);
  font-size: 13px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  animation: splash-fade 0.9s ease 0.2s both;
}
@keyframes splash-in {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.82) translateY(10px); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
}
@keyframes splash-fade {
  0% { opacity: 0; } 100% { opacity: 1; }
}

/* ---------- Layout shells ---------- */
#app { min-height: 100dvh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.screen { min-height: 100dvh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

.topbar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20;
  background: var(--bg);
}
/* Player topbar: title/back on its own row, all the icon controls on a
   second row below — keeps every button fully visible and tappable no
   matter how narrow the phone or how long the song title, instead of
   cramming everything into one row where the last button (or the title)
   gets squeezed off-screen. */
.topbar-player {
  flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch;
  gap: 10px; padding-left: 12px; padding-right: 12px;
}
.topbar-player-row1 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.topbar-player-row2 { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.topbar h1 { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; }
.topbar-editor h1, .topbar-player .player-title h1 { font-size: 16px; }

.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.brand-mark { width: 34px; height: 34px; object-fit: contain; flex-shrink: 0; }
.brand-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.15; min-width: 0; }
.brand-line1 { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--green); letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
.brand-line2 { font-family: 'Sour Display','Sour Body',sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; }

.brand-mark-btn {
  border: none; background: transparent; padding: 0; cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
}
.brand-mark-btn:active { transform: scale(0.94); }
.brand-mark-sm { width: 40px; height: 40px; object-fit: contain; }

.btn-art-mode {
  width: 48px; height: 48px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--green-bright); background: var(--bg-elevated);
  color: var(--green-bright); cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(147,216,62,0.16);
}
.btn-art-mode:active { transform: scale(0.94); }

.topbar-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }

.player-title { flex: 1; min-width: 0; text-align: center; }

.btn-back {
  background: var(--green); color: #0d1a02;
  height: 40px; padding: 0 16px;
  border-radius: 999px; border: none;
  font-weight: 800; font-size: 13.5px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.btn-back:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
.player-title h1 { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

/* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
.icon-btn {
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.icon-btn:active { transform: scale(0.94); }
.icon-btn-danger:hover, .icon-btn-danger:active { color: var(--danger); }

.btn {
  border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 11px 18px;
  transition: transform 0.08s ease;
}
.btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
/* No text-selection / long-press callout on any control button anywhere in
   the app — holding to ramp tempo was accidentally triggering the phone's
   native copy/select popup. */
button {
  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  -webkit-touch-callout: none;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}
.btn-hold, .btn-ramp { touch-action: none; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--green); color: #0d1a02; }
.btn-lg { padding: 14px 24px; font-size: 15px; }
.btn-sm { padding: 7px 12px; font-size: 12.5px; }
.btn-ghost {
  background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}
/* ---------- Library ---------- */
.library-main { flex: 1; padding: 18px 16px 40px; max-width: 760px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; }
.library-heading {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.library-heading h1 { font-size: 22px; }

.song-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
@media (min-width: 560px) { .song-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

.song-card {
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 16px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
}
.song-card:active { transform: scale(0.99); }
.song-card-top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.song-card-top h3 { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; }
.song-card-artist { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-dim); }
.song-card-menu { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.song-card-menu .icon-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; }
.song-card-preview {
  margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--text-dim);
  overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
}

.chip-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 8px; }
.chip-row-tight { justify-content: center; margin-top: 4px; }
.chip {
  font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600;
  padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(111,185,44,0.16); color: var(--green);
}

.empty-state {
  text-align: center; padding: 60px 20px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.empty-mark { color: var(--green); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.empty-state h2 { font-size: 20px; }
.empty-state p { color: var(--text-dim); max-width: 360px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.55; margin: 4px 0 18px; }

/* ---------- Editor ---------- */
.editor-main { flex: 1; padding: 20px 16px 60px; max-width: 640px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.field-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
.field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-dim); }
.field-optional { font-weight: 400; }
input[type="text"], textarea {
  background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 11px 13px; font-size: 15px; font-family: inherit;
  resize: vertical;
}
textarea { line-height: 1.6; min-height: 220px; }
input:focus, textarea:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 1px; }

.photo-preview { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.photo-preview img { width: 84px; height: 84px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid var(--line); }

/* ---------- Reading-mode picker ---------- */
.reading-picker[hidden] { display: none; }
.reading-picker:not([hidden]) {
  position: sticky; top: 128px; z-index: 21;
  display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--bg);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.swatch {
  width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: 'Sour Display','Sour Body',sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.swatch:active { transform: scale(0.94); }
.btn-fontsize {
  width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text);
  font-family: 'Sour Display','Sour Body',sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px;
  cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.btn-fontsize:active { transform: scale(0.94); }
.btn-layout {
  height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text);
  font-family: 'Sour Display','Sour Body',sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800; font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.btn-layout:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

/* Compact on-the-fly chord-layout toggle, sitting right in the player
   topbar next to the reading-colors/invert/edit icons, so switching
   between Standard and SPS Layout never requires opening the reading
   picker or going into edit mode. */
.btn-layout-top {
  height: 40px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text);
  font-family: 'Sour Display','Sour Body',sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.btn-layout-top:active { transform: scale(0.94); }
.btn-layout-top-active {
  border-color: var(--green-bright); color: var(--green-bright);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(147,216,62,0.16);
}

/* ---------- Player ---------- */
.screen-player { height: 100dvh; overflow: hidden; }
.player-body { flex: 1; display: flex; min-height: 0; }

.lyrics-viewport {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  scroll-behavior: auto;
}
.lyrics-body {
  max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 24px 16px 60px;
  font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.75; font-weight: 500;
}

/* Right-hand vertical fader rail — sized for a right thumb to ride up and
   down mid-performance without hunting for a small horizontal slider. */
.fader-rail {
  width: 60px; flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
  gap: 6px; padding: 12px 0 8px;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.fader-label {
  font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--text-dim); flex-shrink: 0;
}
.fader-track {
  position: relative;
  width: 34px; flex: 1;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  touch-action: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.fader-fill {
  position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--green), var(--green-bright));
  height: 30%;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.fader-thumb {
  position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 30%;
  width: 44px; height: 26px;
  transform: translate(-50%, 50%);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.fader-value {
  position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1; pointer-events: none; user-select: none;
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .fader-thumb { background: #F3F1E8; border-color: #F3F1E8; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .fader-value { color: var(--ink); }
.fader-track:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 3px; }
.lyric-section { margin-bottom: 28px; }
.lyric-line { display: block; }
.lyric-line:empty { display: block; height: 0.6em; }
.chord {
  color: var(--green); font-weight: 700;
  font-family: 'Sour Display','Sour Body',sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.72em;
  vertical-align: 0.15em;
  margin-right: 0.05em;
}
.lyrics-empty { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 16px; padding-top: 20px; }

/* Sour Paint Studios chord layout: a chord-cue line sits to the left of
   the lyric line it leads into, instead of stacked above it. */
.lyric-cue-row {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px;
}
.lyric-cue-chord {
  flex: 0 0 auto; min-width: 48px; max-width: 38%;
  text-align: left;
}
.lyric-cue-chord .chord {
  font-size: 0.85em; vertical-align: baseline; margin-right: 0.15em;
}
.lyric-cue-line { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }

.player-controls {
  position: sticky; bottom: 0; z-index: 20;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--bg) 60%, transparent);
  padding: 10px 12px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
}
.control-row {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px;
  max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%;
}
.ramp-row[hidden] { display: none; }
.ramp-row:not([hidden]) {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.7fr 1fr; gap: 6px;
  max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%;
}
.btn-ramp {
  height: 48px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
  font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text); border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  transition: transform 0.08s ease;
}
.btn-ramp svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.btn-ramp:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
.btn-faster { border-color: var(--green-bright); color: var(--green-bright); }
.btn-slower { border-color: var(--yellow); color: var(--yellow); }
/* Faster/Slower only do anything while actually held down — a quick tap
   just re-locks the current speed and looks like nothing happened. Spell
   that out right on the button instead of relying on people to guess it,
   the same way the main hold-to-ramp button already does. */
.ramp-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; line-height: 1.1; }
.ramp-word { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; }
.ramp-hint {
  font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.72;
}
.btn-tap {
  height: 52px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--green-bright); cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
  font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.08s ease, color 0.15s ease;
  background: var(--green-bright); color: #0d1a02;
  font-size: 13px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(212,255,63,0.18);
}
.btn-tap:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
.btn-tap .tap-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.btn-tap[data-status="waiting"] { background: var(--yellow); color: #221f00; border-color: var(--yellow); }
.btn-tap[data-status="success"] { background: var(--green-bright); color: #0d1a02; border-color: var(--green-bright); }

/* Hold-to-ramp button — same footprint as tap, its own color per stage.
   Also the sole play/pause indicator now (no separate Play button). */
.btn-hold {
  height: 52px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
  font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, transform 0.08s ease;
}
.btn-hold .hold-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.btn-hold:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
.hold-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; line-height: 1.15; }
.hold-hint {
  font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.75;
}
.hold-hint[hidden] { display: none; }
.btn-hold[data-status="ready"] {
  background: var(--yellow); color: #221f00; border-color: var(--yellow);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,214,10,0.18);
}
.btn-hold[data-status="scrolling"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-color: var(--line); }
.btn-hold[data-status="stopped"] { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text); border-color: var(--line); }

/* ---------- Modals ---------- */
.modal-backdrop[hidden] { display: none; }
.modal-backdrop:not([hidden]) {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 60;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center;
}
@media (min-width: 560px) {
  .modal-backdrop:not([hidden]) { align-items: center; }
}
.modal-card {
  width: 100%; max-width: 420px;
  background: var(--bg); color: var(--text);
  border-radius: 22px 22px 0 0;
  padding: 28px 24px 32px;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
@media (min-width: 560px) {
  .modal-card { border-radius: 22px; margin: 0 16px; }
}
.modal-logo { width: 56px; height: 56px; object-fit: contain; margin: 0 auto 12px; }
.modal-card h2 { font-family: 'Sour Display','Sour Body',sans-serif; font-size: 20px; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.modal-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-dim); margin: 0 0 20px; line-height: 1.5; }
.modal-url { color: var(--green-bright); font-weight: 700; }
.modal-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
.modal-actions .btn { flex: 1; height: 48px; border-radius: 999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }

/* Art-mode flip-through picker */
.art-wheel-card { padding-top: 24px; }
.art-wheel-sub { margin-bottom: 18px !important; }
.art-wheel-flipzone {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.art-wheel-arrow {
  flex: 0 0 auto; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer;
}
.art-wheel-arrow:active { transform: scale(0.92); }
.art-wheel-card-frame { flex: 1 1 auto; perspective: 900px; }
.art-wheel-flipcard {
  height: 118px; border-radius: 18px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  transition: transform 140ms ease;
  transform: rotateY(0deg);
}
.art-wheel-flipcard.is-flipping { transform: rotateY(90deg); }
.art-wheel-swatches { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
.art-wheel-swatches span {
  width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 7px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
}
.art-wheel-swatch-default {
  width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 7px;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, var(--line), var(--line) 3px, transparent 3px, transparent 6px);
}
.art-wheel-flipcard span#art-wheel-name {
  font-family: 'Sour Display','Sour Body',sans-serif;
  font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--green-bright);
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}
.art-wheel-actions { flex-wrap: wrap; }
.art-wheel-close { margin-top: 10px; width: 100%; height: 44px; border-radius: 999px; }

/* ---------- Toast ---------- */
#toast {
  position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 24px; transform: translate(-50%, 12px);
  background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper);
  padding: 11px 18px; border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease;
  z-index: 1000; max-width: 88vw; text-align: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
#toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }

/* ---------- Accessibility ---------- */
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  * { animation-duration: 0.001ms !important; transition-duration: 0.001ms !important; }
}

/* ---------- Small screens ---------- */
@media (max-width: 380px) {
  .lyrics-body { font-size: 19px; padding-left: 16px; padding-right: 16px; }
  .field-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

</style>
</head>
